observations.behavior: Adds a transactional, row-level lock and metadata cleanup before copying a community skill into a team, and reserves a set of name prefixes to prevent community installs from using PostHog-managed namespaces.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent race conditions where a concurrent catalog sync could replace the skill body between the initial lookup and the copy, potentially installing a hybrid or deleted skill. It also prevents community skills from using reserved namespaces, protecting PostHog-managed skills.

observations.behavior: Adds a check to reject community skill installs that use reserved name prefixes, and removes internal ReviewHog metadata keys before stamping community provenance.
observations.code_quote: raise CommunitySkillInvalidPayloadError("This community skill has no instructions and can't be installed.")
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent community-contributed skills from overwriting or conflicting with PostHog-managed, privileged skills, and could prevent internal metadata from leaking into the installed skill's metadata.

observations.behavior: Adds a check to reject community skill installs that lack a description, and bumps the install counter atomically.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent the installation of un-exportable skills and could provide a mechanism to track the popularity of community skills.

observations.posthog_connection: Protects the community skills API from abuse by rate limiting install and vote requests.
